title.from: Site-supplied procedures: a contract for custom .tac files (M)
title.to: Register site and core procedures automatically on deploy (S)

description.from:
Distinctive Mark ships its own procedure (Distinctive-web procedures/ttab_ruling_analysis.tac). There is no documented way for a site to register a custom procedure kind, have the CLI find it, or run it as a job.

Scope:
- A site declares custom procedures in its config, as kind → path in the site repo.
- They load with the same kind-header validation as core procedures.
- A site kind cannot shadow a core kind unless that is explicitly allowed.
- Site procedures run through either job runner: the cloud construct or the local pod.
- Documented, with Distinctive's ttab_ruling_analysis as the worked example. Moving Distinctive onto the contract is that site's own story.

Acceptance: Gherkin specs for declaring a procedure, loading it, the shadowing refusal, and running it from a site checkout.
description.to:
Scope: at deploy time, register core procedures (from the wheel, PPY-e95a0c) and site procedures (from the site repo) into ProcedureDefinition/ProcedureVersion records in the site's backend, replacing the manual 'npm run seed:amplify' step. Git is the source of truth; the console only views and runs. Note that registration itself already exists: 'papyrus procedures register' (src/papyrus_content/site_procedures.py), which Distinctive's TTAB monitor uses to start distinctive.ttab.ruling-analysis. This story reuses it rather than building a new mechanism, and wires it into the deploy.

Scope:
- Deploy-time registration of core and site procedures, using kind-header validation (PPY-0d4984). A site kind cannot shadow a core kind unless explicitly allowed.
- Drift check: CI fails if a published version differs from the .tac in git.
- Docs: update docs/newsroom-procedures-runbook.md (it lists only 3 of 11 procedures) and docs/procedure-runner.md, with Distinctive's ttab_ruling_analysis as the worked example. Moving Distinctive onto the contract is that site's own story.

Acceptance criteria:
- A deploy registers every core and site procedure with no manual seed step.
- CI fails when a published version differs from git, and passes when they match.
- A site-kind shadowing of a core kind is refused.
- The runbook lists all 11 core procedures and documents the Distinctive example.
- Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) required: registration on deploy, drift failure, shadowing refusal.

Depends on PPY-e95a0c and PPY-0d4984.
